_doc: Projects the release-cut lane cuts (rules: ~/.local/src/docs/stages.md, Release windows, Cut). cut_hour: the local time a window with no cut= is cut on its due day. tests: the full run a cut needs green on main. promote: after the deployment named here succeeds for the tag, the lane files this item once ({tag} and {build} filled in).

promote.item: release(steam): set {tag}'s beta build {build} live on Steam default through store-console on the agent machine, after checking whether the app is publicly released and recording the BuildID it replaces (release.md, Who takes the public step)
